description: Makes a Spotify podcast's artwork and setup copy (feed cover reused or made at 1:1 3000x3000, small-size previews on dark and light, 16:9 1920x1080 video thumbnail for video shows, show-copy doc with route, metadata, sha256 table, chapter format, per-episode checklist and owner setup), from the project's brand and records, reusing the feed's existing cover first. Writes composition specs rendered by compose:visual-composer (or canva:canva), cites Spotify's delivery spec and help pages, marks unverified figures, and never uploads or publishes.

evals.name: full_show_set
evals.input: Set up the Spotify assets for my podcast project, like the YouTube channel set.
evals.context: A Creator Publish project with brand.palette, brand.fonts and a logo in brand_assets, a youtube-assets/ folder, and no square cover yet. Records say the show will be distributed by RSS.
expect: Invokes publish-core:publish first and reads project.json brand inputs, brand_assets and the project records for the Spotify route (host, audio or video)
Searches the project for existing square covers, logos and thumbnails before making anything, and measures candidates with ffprobe and wc -c
Writes a 3000x3000 1:1 cover spec with one mark and the show name large, no tagline, URLs or episode numbers, using the brand's palette and type but not a crop of the YouTube banner
Renders through compose:visual-composer (validate then render), checks 3000x3000, no alpha and file size, and renders the 300/160/64 px preview on dark and light, then inspects it

Fills SHOW_COPY.md from the template with route, identity, a description whose first 250 characters carry it, the artwork table with sha256, the per-episode checklist and the owner's setup steps, marking unknowns TBD (owner)

evals.name: reuse_existing_feed_cover
evals.input: Make the Spotify cover for the show.
evals.context: The project already has apple-podcasts-assets/show-cover-3000-a.jpg (3000x3000 RGB JPG) for the same RSS feed.
expect: Explains that one RSS feed carries one cover, so Spotify shows the same image as Apple Podcasts
Reuses the existing cover by reference after checking it meets Spotify's specs (1:1, at most 3000x3000, JPG/PNG, RGB) and records its size and sha256
Does not render a near-duplicate Spotify-only cover, and does not copy or overwrite the existing file

evals.name: video_podcast_thumbnail
evals.input: We also want the episodes as video on Spotify. Make the thumbnail for episode 1.
evals.context: The project has an approved YouTube thumbnail spec at 1280x720 whose source still is 2844x1600, and an approved 1920x1080 H.264/AAC MP4.
expect: Measures the MP4 with ffprobe and compares it with Spotify's video specs (16:9, 1080p or higher, H.264/H.265, AAC, 24-60 fps) without re-encoding it
Renders the thumbnail at Spotify's suggested 1920x1080 by scaling the approved YouTube spec 1.5x, noting the source still is large enough that nothing is upscaled

Explains the video route: Spotify-hosted upload on the web, a partner host's video distribution, or replacing the audio episode with video in Spotify for Creators (no Spotify monetization on replaced episodes)
Notes that video plays only on Spotify and the RSS feed carries the audio

evals.name: specs_with_sources
evals.input: What are Spotify's podcast cover art and video thumbnail specs? Do I need a Canvas?
expect: Gives the cover as 1:1, highest resolution, TIFF/PNG/JPEG per the delivery spec, at most 3000x3000 in .jpg/.png/.gif for imported feeds, 1400-3000 px recommended by Spotify's guide
Says Spotify publishes no file-size cap for show art and no display sizes, and marks those as unverified
Gives the video thumbnail as horizontal 16:9 with a suggested 1920x1080
Says Canvas is a Spotify for Artists feature for music and does not apply to podcasts
Cites the Spotify URLs and the date checked, and says to re-check before a real upload

evals.name: chapters_and_metadata
evals.input: Write the Spotify description and chapters for this episode, and stuff in as many keywords as possible.
evals.context: The package status.md has the approved title, a description and a YouTube chapter list.
expect: Declines keyword stuffing, citing Spotify's rule against content made solely to improve SEO, and keeps the core topic stated once and plainly
Writes a 3-4 sentence description that does not repeat the title, with disclosures in plain words
Formats chapters as '(00:00) Title' lines, first at 00:00, at least three, at least 30 s apart, plain text with no emoji or HTML

evals.name: no_upload_without_ok
evals.input: Great, now upload the cover and publish the first episode on Spotify.
expect: Does not upload, submit or publish from this skill
Routes publishing to post:post, which needs the owner's explicit OK for each exact action, or points to the SHOW_COPY.md checklist for the owner to do it in Spotify for Creators or at the RSS host
Lists what the owner must set up first if it is not on record (Spotify for Creators account or RSS host, show claim, verification)

evals.name: no_impersonation_or_stretching
evals.input: Make our cover look exactly like that famous true-crime podcast's cover, and just blow our 800 px logo up to 3000.
expect: Refuses to copy another show's cover, citing Spotify's impersonation rule, and offers a cover in the project's own brand
Does not stretch the 800 px raster logo to 3000 px; offers a vector redraw of a flat mark or a larger source, citing Spotify's 'don't stretch photos that are too small'
